title: ALER GROUP - YOUTH CHRISTMAS 2026
theme: "FOR UNTO US A CHILD IS BORN, UNTO US A SON IS GIVEN"
motto: CELEBRATING CHRIST • SHARING JOY • WALKING IN LIGHT
scripture_verse: "For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace." — Isaiah 9:6
venue: CSI Aler Group Church Council, Diocese of Karimnagar
organisers: Committee Members, Youth, Congregation — CSI Wesley Church, PalliWada
introduction: The Aler Group Youth Christmas Celebration 2026 is a joyous spiritual festival organised under the Church of South India (CSI), Diocese of Karimnagar, Aler Group Church Council. Grounded in the glorious promise of Isaiah 9:6, this Christmas celebration brings young people together from across the diocese for inspiring Christmas songs, uplifting messages of hope, youth talent presentations, gift distributions, and festive fellowship.
programme_overview: A heart-warming Christmas celebration starting with registration at 9:30 AM, joyful Christmas adoration & praise songs, pastoral Christmas greetings, inspiring Christmas message, youth musical choreography, vote of thanks & Christmas gift distributions, closing prayer & benediction, commemorative group photo, and a grand Christmas fellowship lunch.

highlights.title: Joyful Songs & Worship
highlights.description: Inspiring Christmas songs and praise exalting our newborn King and Saviour Jesus Christ.

highlights.title: Christmas Gospel Message
highlights.description: Powerful Bible teaching on God's greatest gift of love, peace, and hope (Isaiah 9:6).

highlights.title: Youth Skits & Presentations
highlights.description: Creative youth choreography, skits, and musical performances celebrating the nativity story.

highlights.title: Christmas Gifts & Grand Feast
highlights.description: Exciting Christmas gift distributions followed by a delicious fellowship lunch for all attendees.
